verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents a one-command local dev mode (`start-dev` via Docker), isolated realms that work like tenants, and realm import/export as JSON. Together these let a user stand up a separate non-production instance or realm to test against. It is not a purpose-built sandbox, though, and community reports say promoting configuration from test to production is hard because config lives in the database. missing for 10: dedicated sandbox/test-mode environment, seeded test data or fixtures, first-party test-to-production config promotion, independent corroboration of sandbox-style testing workflows.
